title: Taiwanese American Professionals Atlanta 台美菁英協會亞特蘭大分會
content_html: Taiwanese American Professionals Atlanta (TAP-ATL) is a chapter of the Taiwanese American Citizens League (TACL), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit run entirely by volunteers. TAP-ATL serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Atlanta area by organizing monthly TAPpy Hours and larger quarterly events focused on social networking, professional development, and cultural celebration. The chapter welcomes people of all cultures and backgrounds.
